categories.name: Signal Vault
categories.purpose: A compact playable puzzle adventure demonstrating a game-first experience with controls, collectibles, level state and win/lose conditions.
categories.target_audience: Casual puzzle players and indie game teams
categories.ux_direction: Playable grid puzzler with mission brief on the left, the game board as the main surface and a compact mission HUD on the right.
categories.primary_data_model: Level, Tile, PlayerState, Collectible, Exit, Move, Timer, MissionState
categories.core_user_flows: Move with keyboard or on-screen controls; avoid walls; collect three shards; reach the exit; restart after a win or timeout.
categories.implementation_notes: No account, multiplayer, monetization or external services. The maze and objective are a self-contained demonstration. The implementation brief describes a small browser game, not a general-purpose game engine.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Signal Vault as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Fable Screenroom
categories.purpose: A lightweight entertainment discovery and playback workspace for browsing curated audio and series collections, starting playback and managing a personal queue.
categories.target_audience: Listeners and viewers using a small curated media service
categories.ux_direction: Editorial media storefront with large featured series artwork, a horizontal collection shelf and a persistent bottom playback bar.
categories.primary_data_model: MediaItem, Collection, Episode, Track, PlaybackState, QueueItem, Favourite
categories.core_user_flows: Browse a collection; choose a media item; play/pause; skip tracks; seek; save or unsave an item.
categories.implementation_notes: All titles, creators and cover art are fictional. Playback is simulated; no copyrighted media, streaming API or media files are bundled. A production system needs rights metadata and playback entitlement checks.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Fable Screenroom as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Commonroom
categories.purpose: A focused community product for sharing posts, discovering topic spaces, finding discussions and reacting to member contributions.
categories.ux_direction: Community feed with space navigation, inline post composer, Latest/Popular/Following tabs and a compact discovery sidebar.
categories.primary_data_model: Member, Space, Membership, Post, Reaction, Reply, Topic, FeedPreference
categories.core_user_flows: Compose a post; publish to the feed; like/unlike a post; switch feed tabs; search visible discussions.
categories.implementation_notes: Demo members and content are fictional. No private messaging, dating, livestreaming or real identity verification is included. Production needs moderation, reporting, blocking, abuse controls, consent and privacy settings.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Commonroom as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Takeform Studio
categories.purpose: A creator production desk for assembling a podcast/newsletter episode, managing assets, editing release notes and checking distribution readiness.
categories.target_audience: Independent podcasters, newsletter writers and small creator teams
categories.ux_direction: Dark production workspace with project asset rail, central audio sequence and script/description editor, plus release-health checklist.

categories.implementation_notes: Audio playback is simulated and no audio is distributed. Production requires media processing, transcoding, rights/consent management, channel adapters and immutable release versions.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Takeform Studio as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Folio Press
categories.purpose: A desktop publishing workspace for composing a magazine spread, managing pages and adjusting headline typography before print/export.
categories.target_audience: Editorial designers and small publishing teams
categories.ux_direction: Desktop publishing-style workspace with page thumbnails, central two-page spread, compact ribbon tools and typography inspector.
categories.primary_data_model: Publication, Issue, Page, Spread, TextFrame, ImageFrame, Style, FontAsset, ExportJob

categories.implementation_notes: Page content is illustrative. Browser print is a stand-in for true press-ready PDF generation. Production requires precise layout, font embedding/licensing, bleed, trim, colour management and preflight.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Folio Press as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Batchdocs
categories.purpose: A mail-merge and document-generation tool that maps structured dataset columns into approved document templates and previews a batch before export.
categories.target_audience: Operations, HR and admin teams generating recurring documents
categories.ux_direction: Step-based document workflow: template and dataset configuration, field mapping table, live document preview and recipient review.
categories.primary_data_model: Template, TemplateVersion, Dataset, DatasetRow, FieldMapping, Recipient, GeneratedDocument, BatchJob
categories.core_user_flows: Choose a template and dataset; inspect mappings; navigate sample recipients; review records; generate a local demo batch.
categories.implementation_notes: All customer/contract data is synthetic. No email or signature is sent. Production needs document snapshotting, validation, auditability, secure storage, permissions and optional e-signature integration.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Batchdocs as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Bento Builder
categories.purpose: A visual internal-tool builder for composing a small operations portal from reusable components bound to simple data sources.
categories.ux_direction: Three-panel app builder: component palette, live application canvas and component inspector. This composes application UI, not process automations.

categories.implementation_notes: The canvas uses sample data and component definitions. No production code generation or deployment occurs. Production needs schema validation, component permissions, responsive constraints, versioning and safe execution.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Bento Builder as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Switchboard
categories.purpose: A trigger-condition-action automation builder with an execution monitor for inspecting and testing integration workflows.
categories.target_audience: Small teams automating cross-app business processes
categories.ux_direction: Dark node canvas with connected trigger, condition and action steps, workflow list and live execution log. Distinct from low-code UI composition.
categories.primary_data_model: Workflow, WorkflowVersion, Trigger, Condition, Action, Connector, CredentialReference, Run, RunStep, ExecutionLog
categories.core_user_flows: Inspect workflow; append a step; test a sample execution; pause/resume automation; view execution outcomes.
categories.implementation_notes: All connectors are simulated; no credentials or real actions are executed. Production requires secret management, retries, idempotency, rate limits, sandboxing, run cancellation and audit logs.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Switchboard as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Scout
categories.purpose: A cross-source search interface that combines keyword queries with source filters, result snippets and an in-context document preview.
categories.target_audience: Knowledge workers searching across team files, notes, code and conversations
categories.ux_direction: Search-first page with large universal query bar, source facets, ranked result list and a preview pane.
categories.primary_data_model: SearchQuery, SearchSource, SearchDocument, Snippet, Facet, SearchResult, RankingSignal, PreviewReference
categories.core_user_flows: Edit and submit a query; filter sources; select results; inspect their preview; open a source placeholder.
categories.implementation_notes: Search corpus and snippets are synthetic. No external index or connector is required. Production should enforce source permissions at query time, support ACL-aware indexing, deletion propagation and explainable ranking.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Scout as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.

categories.name: Atlas
categories.purpose: A linked knowledge workspace for authoring notes, navigating a collection tree, viewing concept relationships and discovering backlinks.
categories.target_audience: Researchers, technical leads and personal knowledge managers
categories.ux_direction: Three-column knowledge environment: collection tree, long-form note with embedded concept graph, and backlinks/entity panel.
categories.primary_data_model: KnowledgeSpace, Collection, Note, Block, Entity, Relation, Backlink, Tag, GraphNode, GraphEdge
categories.core_user_flows: Open a note; edit its title; create a new note; navigate related concepts; show/hide the graph; add a relationship.
categories.implementation_notes: Content and relationships are synthetic. The graph is a small illustrative SVG, not a dynamic ontology editor. Production needs version history, graph integrity, backlinks, access control, import/export and citation/source metadata.
categories.agent_implementation_brief: Implement Atlas as a small, practical application with its own category-specific UX. Use local seeded data, implement the primary workflow, add domain and route tests, document demo-only integrations, and require no paid external API credentials.
